step1.bullet2: Make sure you have a Telegram account and are currently logged in.

step2.bullet1: Open Telegram and search for @BotFather in the search bar.
step2.bullet2: Click on the official BotFather account — it has a blue verified checkmark.

step3.bullet1: Click the Start button at the bottom of the chat to activate BotFather.

step4.bullet1: Type /newbot and send the message to BotFather to create a new bot.

step5.bullet1: Type the name you want to give your bot (e.g. Bot test).
step5.bullet2: Choose a username for it — it must end in bot (e.g. test_telegram_04_bot).
step5.bullet3: Copy the token from the BotFather message — you will need it in the next step.

step6.title: Almost there!
step6.subtitle: Paste the token you copied from BotFather below.
